cases.title: PROOF OF INSTALLED FIX BUG-467: with the UCS turned 30 degrees, BT1 on two typed points puts the brace at the World place of the first point with a 30 degree run; back in World UCS, BT1 gives the same 2400 mm, 30 degree brace at its typed point
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from the code at 204dfad2 and the p15 report; not compared with a run.
cases.expected: After _.UCS _Z 30 (UCSXDIR about 0.866,0.5), BT1 typed 17700,-3300 then 20100,-3300, truss number 1, flip No: the command line says "Preview length: 2400  rotation: 30", exactly one new BRACING block on layer WALL BRACING TYPE BT1, inserted within 1 mm of World 16978.650,5992.116 (not at 17700,-3300). After _.UCS _W, BT1 typed 16978.650,8992.116 then 19057.111,10192.116: again "Preview length: 2400  rotation: 30" and a second BRACING block within 1 mm of 16978.650,8992.116. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit tests only pin the source (HuntS02UcsTests.cs); only AutoCAD's live UCS turns a typed point, and only the real BT1 and its jig show where the brace lands.
not_automated: The angle is read from BT1's own command-line line, not from the block: the brace's rotation is a dynamic grip value that ent-read does not return (the block's own rotation stays 0 by design).
The drag preview following the cursor in the rotated UCS needs the mouse: Codex look (CODEX_LOOK_STRUC_467_472_30OCT.txt).
The truss tag text position on the drawing is recorded (ent-read attributes), not judged.
